description: A line under the shear x += 0.5y. A DWG INSERT carries scale, rotation and translation but no shear, so I expect the path to classify this as unrepresentable and quarantine it, not to emit a silently different curve.

profile_only.reason: A single INSERT carries a translation, one rotation, three scales and no shear, so no writer can store this matrix in one INSERT and there is no DWG for this record on purpose. It is a profile-only probe: it states what pvec must do with a single stored matrix of this kind (pvec ADR 0012 and 0017). The DWG path is covered by shear-chain-001, a three-INSERT chain that reaches the same world-space line.
